GoogleCalendarService then passes this wrapper as `data: { key }` to prisma.credential.update, so the stored Credential.key becomes `{success:true, data:{...}}`, losing the top-level token fields expected by googleCredentialSchema on subsequent loads. In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the refresh path was changed from `googleCredentialSchema.parse(googleCredentials)` to `const key = parseRefreshTokenResponse(googleCredentials, googleCredentialSchema);` and then persisted via `prisma.credential.update({ data: { key } })`. That would store the wrapper into `Credential.key`, changing the stored shape and breaking subsequent code that expects `Credential.key` to match `googleCredentialSchema` (previously parsed/stored as the actual credentials object).
